813-4875-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
813-4875-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Conspiracy, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

950-1557-4613.easyPrerequisites:
Siren of the Silent Song doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Fatestitcher is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
950-1557-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
950-1557-4613.description:
Activate Siren of the Silent Song using Fatestitcher's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Fatestitcher's ability by tapping it, untapping Siren of the Silent Song
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard and mill a card.
Repeat.

69-539-2930-3172.easyPrerequisites:
Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Thespian's Stage and Portent Tracker do not have summoning sickness.
69-539-2930-3172.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Put Patron of the Orochi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Thespian's Stage.
Activate Thespian's Stage using Patron of the Orochi's ability by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage using its own ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of itself, which causes it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Repeat from step 4.
69-539-2930-3172.notes: If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

391-2645-3430-5233.easyPrerequisites: Blossom Dryad doesn't have summoning sickness.
391-2645-3430-5233.description:
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Boros Garrison
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

628-7198-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Flitterwing Nuisance.
When Flitterwing Nuisance dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

777-1170-5131-5315--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
777-1170-5131-5315--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Foundry Inspector.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

824-2728-5231-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-5231-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-5231-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

3809-4682-5140-7824.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
3809-4682-5140-7824.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create two Treasure tokens due to Bard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Repeat.
3809-4682-5140-7824.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4264-4753.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4264-4753.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Clever Impersonator each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4264-4753.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3821-3859-5921.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{U}{B}.
3821-3859-5921.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying its mana cost.
When Cavern Harpy enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

803-997-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
803-997-4302.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3059-4522-7408.notablePrerequisites: Quest for Pure Flame has at least four quest counters on it.
3059-4522-7408.description:
Activate Quest for Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and  sacrificing it.
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}. It'll enter with power equal to half the highest life total among your opponents, rounded up.
When Malignus enters, Champion of the Path triggers, causing Malignus to deal damage equal to its power doubled to each opponent due to Quest for Pure Flame.
3059-4522-7408.notes: Malignus also makes the damage unpreventable due to its static effect. This combo should result in each opponent losing the game except in niche circumstances.

240-2921-3480-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

2615-6562-7175.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
2615-6562-7175.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

1606-4038-5963.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands.
1606-4038-5963.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Marvin using Ley Weaver's ability by tapping it, untapping the two lands.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

343-2079-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
343-2079-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-3755-7060-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-3755-7060-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-2034-3490-4716.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2034-3490-4716.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

934-2097-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2541-2919-6428.notablePrerequisites:
Magmakin Artillerist has lifelink.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
2541-2919-6428.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Magmakin Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2092-3862-4013.easyPrerequisites: You do not control an Army.
2034-2092-3862-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying at most {1}{C}, blinking Orcish Bowmasters.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target and creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Orc Army, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2105-3719-5256-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven creatures, excluding Combat Celebrant, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Combat Celebrant or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
2105-3719-5256-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping seven creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

813-1567-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
813-1567-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng and Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

3490-5147-5346.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one artifact creature.
3490-5147-5346.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an artifact creature
Crime Novelist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to add {R}.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2440-3705-4050-5115.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Goblins.
2440-3705-4050-5115.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Squee enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
If you control four or more Goblins, this combo nets infinite mana.

1295-1887-5305.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is equal to or greater than the number of cards in hand minus two.
1295-1887-5305.description:
Cast Mordenkainen by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Mordenkainen enters the battlefield with ten loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate Mordenkainen's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it.
Mordenkainen dies as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Mordenkainen ability, exchanging your hand and library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

914-1799-2034-2048.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1799-2034-2048.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard on the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Dockside Extortionist from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then onto the battlefield.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.
